messages.subject: R/Bioc intro in Ukraine
parts:
Dear all, 

I also wanted to share with you that last week, I taught the R/Bioc intro course at the Biological Data Science Summer School in Uzhhorod, Ukraine, and it was very well received. Participants were quite impressed with how well the course was structured. 

Thank you all for your contributions! 

Best wishes,

Laurent
